title: Automation workflows keep job GITHUB_TOKEN at contents: read; PR writes go through the App token
answers: Why does my workflow job fail with 403 when creating or updating a pull request?
Which permissions should a GitHub Actions job get for GITHUB_TOKEN in this repo?
Can I add pull-requests: write to a job's permissions block?
How do automated bot PRs get write access in the MLflow workflows?
body:
Invariant: job-level `permissions` in the automation workflows (.github/workflows/uv.yml, remove-experimental-decorators.yml, update-model-catalog.yml `create-pr` job) is `contents: read`. No `pull-requests: write` or `contents: write` is granted to the job GITHUB_TOKEN.
Where: the `permissions:` block of each job in those files; PR-writing steps authenticate with the `mlflow-app` token from `actions/create-github-app-token` (its `permission-*` inputs carry the write scopes).
Why: the PR removed `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write` from these jobs, while the App token was kept as the write path. Unused write scopes on GITHUB_TOKEN were the reduction target.
Breaks if skipped: adding write scopes back to the job token widens what any step in that job can do; moving a PR step onto GITHUB_TOKEN without the scope fails with 403.
Constraints: inferred from the PR description and diff, not from a reviewer comment. Whether a given step truly needs the App token (vs. the job token) must be checked per step. The publish job in update-model-catalog.yml uses secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN with its own permissions and is not covered by this note.
applies: Job-level permissions of the automation workflows listed above; check each step's token source before changing the permissions block.
says: Automation jobs fail with permission denied errors when attempting to open pull requests.
Automated maintenance tasks cannot push changes or update pull requests in the repository.
Restrict default workflow permissions while allowing automated pull requests through dedicated app credentials.
Model catalog update tasks fail with permission errors during pull request creation.
search: Automation workflow jobs must restrict job-level GITHUB_TOKEN permissions to contents: read, using dedicated GitHub App tokens for pull request writes. In .github/workflows/uv.yml, remove-experimental-decorators.yml, and the create-pr job of update-model-catalog.yml, PR-writing steps authenticate via actions/create-github-app-token to avoid granting contents: write or pull-requests: write to the job token. Assigning write scopes to the job token exposes unnecessary permissions, while executing PR steps with GITHUB_TOKEN without scopes triggers 403 errors. Applies to job-level permissions in those specific automation workflows, whereas the publish job in update-model-catalog.yml uses secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN and is excluded.
